title: Anna_Becker
summary:
Anna Becker is an Israeli researcher known in the field of artificial intelligence and computer science within the financial field. Becker was born in Russia and immigrated to Israel at 16 after graduating from a school in Moscow. At 17, she began her studies at Technion - Israel Institute of Technology. During her master's degree in computer science, she taught first-year students of the same course, and at 27, Becker completed her PhD in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence.

While pursuing her PhD, Becker resolved an NP-complete approximation algorithm that had been unresolved for over twenty years, which made her a recognized scholar in the field. After completing her PhD, she developed an approximation technique by a factor of two. This technique is widely used today in operating systems, database systems, and VLSI chip designs.

She founded and sold Strategy Runner, a fintech software. Dr. Anna Becker is the CEO and Co-founder of EndoTech.io, where she leads the AI/ML teams. Anna's deep-learning algorithms have managed nearly a billion dollars of investment and have been deployed in managing institutional monies for more than a decade. From 2017 until 2019, Dr. Anna Becker served as a member of the Financial Commission's Dispute Resolution Committee. In March 2019, Dr. Becker resigned from this position. The EndoTech platform has been developed by more than 40 fully dedicated quant developers and leverages more than 200 distinct AI modules.
